answer: A mechanism that actually bites: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because oasis only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, horizon is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any ember approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
